questions.question: After the Israelites heard God speak from heaven, what did He tell them they must not make for themselves?

answers.text: A king to rule over them
A tower that reaches the sky

questions.question: God told the Israelites never to oppress foreigners living among them. What reason did He give?

answers.text: They were once foreigners in Egypt

questions.question: God told the Israelites that if a mistreated widow or orphan cried out to Him, He would surely hear their cry. True or false?
God told the Israelites to sow their land for six years and let it rest in the seventh. What did He say that rest was for?

answers.text: So the poor can eat from it
So the priests can harvest it
